commands.name: search-competitions
commands.summary: Search WCA competitions like the /competitions page: keyword, event, country and date filters, sorted and paginated with 25 per page

commands.name: list-competitions
commands.summary: List competitions through the public API, filtered by country and a start/end date range, with sort and pagination

commands.name: get-competition
commands.summary: Get one competition's details: dates, venue, registration settings, fees and information

commands.name: get-competition-results
commands.summary: Get a competition's results for one event, round by round, with each competitor's position, best, average and attempts

commands.name: get-competition-scrambles
commands.summary: Get the official scrambles a competition used for one event, grouped by round

commands.name: get-competition-wcif
commands.summary: Get a competition's public WCIF: events, rounds, formats, time limits, cutoffs, schedule/venues and registered persons with their assignments

commands.name: list-competition-competitors
commands.summary: List the people who competed in or are registered for a competition

commands.name: search-persons
commands.summary: Search WCA competitors by name or WCA id; each result includes competition count and personal records with ranks

commands.name: get-person
commands.summary: Get a competitor's profile by WCA id: country, delegate status, teams, competition count and personal records (single/average with world, continent and country ranks)

commands.name: get-person-results
commands.summary: List every result a competitor has, one row per round: competition, event, round, position, best, average, attempts

commands.name: get-person-competitions
commands.summary: List the competitions a competitor has attended

commands.name: get-records
commands.summary: Get current world, continental and national records (single and average) for every event

commands.name: search-site
commands.summary: Site-wide search (the navbar omnisearch) that returns matching people and competitions

commands.name: list-posts
commands.summary: List WCA news and announcement posts, newest first, 10 per page

dropped.name: get-competition-calendar
dropped.reason: The .ics is an empty VCALENDAR with no VEVENT, so it has no competition data. The endpoint was guessed rather than recorded (source is the HTML page). get-competition already covers the dates and venue.
